name: Notes
description: Notes on the canvas: floating sticky notes, one with a title and free text and one shaped as a table (key and value), to comment on a screen, record a business rule, list the data of an event or leave a message for whoever reads the mapping; and plain text, loose on the canvas or inside a container, for labels, titles and captions.

annotationTypes.name: Note
annotationTypes.description: Loose comment on the canvas (this screen is for X, a business rule). It belongs to no screen: it sits on top of everything and neither carries nor is carried by what is underneath. The relation to a screen or an element is an arrow.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short summary of the note; shown in bold at the top of the sticky note. Can be left empty.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The comment itself. Accepts multiple lines: Shift+Enter breaks the line (Enter confirms while the field is a single line; in the multi-line area, Enter also inserts a line).

values.texto: Only sign up with an approved limit.

annotationTypes.name: Table
annotationTypes.description: Loose key-value table on the canvas (the properties of an event, the parameters of a call). It belongs to no screen: it sits on top of everything and neither carries nor is carried by what is underneath. The relation to a screen or an element is an arrow.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Short summary of the table; shown in bold at the top. Can be left empty.

fields.label: Rows
fields.description: One row per record: the key on the left and the value on the right.

columns.label: Key
columns.description: The name of the data item (a property, a parameter).

examples.name: Analytics event
examples.description: Only the title goes into an example; the rows (source, items, total) come from the component preview.

annotationTypes.name: Text
annotationTypes.description: Plain text with no frame: a label, a title or a caption, loose on the canvas or inside a container. Where it lives is decided by geometry, as for any marking; inside a container it follows the container. Turn Floating on to put it above everything.

fields.label: Text
fields.description: The text itself. Accepts multiple lines: Shift+Enter breaks the line.

fields.label: Size
fields.description: Font size in the component's units (multiplied by the container's density). Empty draws 14.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: Text color as #RRGGBB. Empty draws #1F1F1F. The value is not checked: it goes to the drawing as it is.

fields.label: Width
fields.description: auto: the box follows the text and a line breaks only where one was typed. fixa: the text wraps at the marking's width and only the height follows. Empty draws auto.
